u0: No client is currently waiting and no order is in progress. Watch for a client to arrive at the counter; when client_arrived fires, move to face the client and take the order.
u1: A client is waiting and the order has not been taken yet. Go to the cell next to the client and toggle to take the order.
u2: The order is taken but the agent is not carrying any food. Go to the pantry and pick up a portion of raw food so holding_food becomes true.
u3: The agent holds raw or prepared food with the order taken but food not yet prepared. Bring the food to the stove (only possible while the waiting client's order is taken) and toggle to prepare it; if the food slips, transition to the recovery state.
u4: Prepared food is in hand and the client's order is taken and unserved. Go to the waiting client, face them, and toggle to serve; a slip here means the prepared food must be recovered and re-prepared.
u5: The food slipped out of the agent's hands before it was prepared. Immediately move to pick up the fallen food on the very next move (the agent turns to face it), then return to the preparing state.
u6: Prepared food slipped out of the agent's hands. On the very next move, go to the fallen food and pick it up so the prepared portion is recovered.
u7: The agent has recovered the fallen prepared food and holds it again; the order is still taken and the food is already prepared or needs final preparation. If it is prepared, head to the client to serve; if a prepare event applies, prepare at the stove first.
u8: Recovered prepared food slipped again while the order is still waiting. Move immediately to pick up the fallen food so the prepared portion is recovered once more.
u9: The agent has re-picked up the slipped food after a second slip and holds it again. Bring it to the stove to prepare (if needed) and then to the waiting client to serve; another slip sends it back to recovery.
